# Poetry Codex

> Poetry Codex (https://poetrycodex.com) is a free, advertisement-free archive of the world's poetry in the public domain, edited by an international group of academics. It holds over 100,000 poems and the great epics in their classic translations, from Gilgamesh, Homer and the Mahabharata to the modern poets, with study guides and line-by-line study notes written by its editors. Every text is in the public domain; the editors' guides and notes are original.

## What is here

- Poems: https://poetrycodex.com/poem/<poet>/<n>/ (one page per poem, with its source, translator and date)
- Poets: https://poetrycodex.com/poet/<poet>/ (biography and list of works)
- Long works and epics, with every book or canto on its own page: https://poetrycodex.com/work/<work>/
- Study guides (summary and analysis of every book, characters, themes, critical debates, key passages, questions and a scholarly bibliography): https://poetrycodex.com/guide/<work>/
- Sitemap of all pages: https://poetrycodex.com/sitemap.xml

## Articles

- Notes from the Codex (the editors' blog): https://poetrycodex.com/blog/

## Citing

Each poem page gives its source edition and translator. To cite the editors' study guides: "Poetry Codex editors, '<Title>: Study Guide', Poetry Codex, <URL>, accessed <date>."
